name: i.safe MOBILE IS655.2
statusNote: Discontinued by i.safe MOBILE. The IS880.2 is its successor.
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS655.2 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) smartphone from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx, and for Class I Division 2 in North America. It runs Android 10. It has been discontinued; the i.safe MOBILE IS880.2 replaces it.

otherSchemes: KCs: Ex ic IIC T4 / Ex ic IIIB T135°C

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc IP54 / II 3D Ex ic IIIB T135°C Dc IP54

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T4 Gc IP54 / Ex ic IIIB T135°C Dc IP54

certification.northAmerica: NEC500 Class I Div 2 Groups A-D T4; Class II Div 2 Groups F,G T135°C; Class III Div 2

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Also certified for Class I Division 2 in North America
Certified for ambient temperatures up to +60 °C
limitations: Discontinued; the i.safe MOBILE IS880.2 replaces it
Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Dust group IIIB: not rated for conductive dust
